custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test at a cost of $10.00, with 5 in bin location A and 0 in bin location B, so the report has two bins to add up.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425664 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425664-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, click Add Bin Location, pick a second bin location in the new row and type 0 in its Quantity, click Default on that second row, then click Save.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line from bin location B while it holds 0, so bin location B goes to -2.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425664 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the work order's Lines tab, in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425664-A in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 2 in Qty *, then click Save.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's Total Qty reads "5 Available", the positive bin only: the -2 in bin location B is not taken off what can be picked.

Step 2:

  • The Reports page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Inventory Value report opens.

Step 4:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 5:

  • The Inventory Value report, by contrast, shows Qty 3.00 for part A (5 + (-2)): only the report moved to the net figure.
